entities.summary: Mitchell Blake Easter is an American musician, songwriter and record producer. Frequently associated with the jangle pop style of guitar music, he is known as producer of R.E.M.'s early albums, from 1981 through 1984, and as frontman of the 1980s band Let's Active. Mitch Easter was a composers & musicians from Winston-Salem (b. 1954-11-15, Winston-Salem). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
